title: Criteria Ranker criteria set
description: A criteria set for https://alternatives.jonashw.dev/toolkit/criteria-ranker.html, pasted into 'Try it with your own criteria' or carried in a link as #data=<base64url of this JSON>. Three shapes: a plain list (title + criteria), one decision (add alternatives and scores), or a parent with parts (add parts). See toolkit/README.md, 'Try it with your own criteria'.

title.description: The page heading, such as "Rank what matters for the team chat tool".

key.description: Optional. Joined with a hash of the criteria ids to name where answers are saved in the viewer's browser.

question.description: List only: the question on each pair. Default "Which matters more to you?".

more.description: List only: as in "Last time you said: X matters more". Default "matters more".

noun.description: List only: what the items are, plural. Default "criteria".

id.description: A short stable code, such as COST. The copied record lists answers by it (COST > EASE).

name.description: One plain sentence saying what good looks like, requirement number first: "R2 Results reach the right person with no copy and paste".

note.description: Optional. Shown under the criterion, for example where the analyst is unsure.

scores.description: One decision only: one score per alternative, in order, 0 to 5 (1 poor, 5 excellent).

director.description: Optional. Scored on the page with one tap per option instead of by scores.

alternatives.description: One decision: the options, each starting with a short code ("A Hosted chat service"). Every criterion then needs scores, unless it is a director criterion.

draftWeights.description: Optional, with alternatives or parts: the analyst's draft weights by criterion id, such as {"COST": 30}. The page says whether they pick the same winner.

gates.description: Pass or fail checks (viability gates). One decision: each gate also has pass, one 1 or 0 per alternative. Parent with parts: id and name here, results in each part's gates.

parts.description: A parent with parts: the criteria carry no scores; each part has its own options and scores.

twoWay.description: Not scored: shown as "two-way door: prototype it".

scores.description: By criterion id; a part uses only the criteria it scores.

gates.description: By gate id: 1 pass, 0 fail, one per option.

pass.description: One decision only: 1 pass, 0 fail, one per alternative, in order.
